gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-roboto: Stencil-cut and loud, Wallpoet takes the stage with gaps where the paper peeks through. Roboto follows in sans-serif form, its generous round letters and low contrast giving the heading room to bark while the text stays easygoing.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-saira: Commanding from the first word, Wallpoet cuts its letters with a thin line of daylight through them. Saira comes next, a sans with see-through s shapes and rounded forms stretching up high, which feels like a quiet reply to all that stencil.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sofia-sans-semi-cond: Distinctive in its huge lowercase, Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness, with daylight inside each curve. And Sofia Sans Semi Condensed carries on that constant weight, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, so the two feel cut from related stock.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-savate: Goldman spreads its letters wide, with round forms like open parentheses and a big lowercase. Savate takes over with sturdy hairlines and open jaws on every curve, and that gentle weight shift along its curves is what sets it apart from the heading.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-preahvihear: Autour One looks bent from a single length of tubing, with no thin-to-thick shift anywhere. Preahvihear takes the text, its open mouths and lofty x-height making paragraphs feel spacious and unhurried beneath that rounded heading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-stack-sans-notch: Metamorphous spaces its letters generously, with a high midline and only a restrained swell in its curves. Stack Sans Notch then reads like rod stock, steady and open, with big-bodied lowercase that rolls along easily.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-amiko: Expressive and loud, Warnes uses round bowls that never swell or thin. Warnes does the showy work with its tapering ink strokes, while Amiko keeps its sans text sturdy, with tall lowercase and terminals flaring outward like tongs.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla sits low and friendly, with wide s curves barely curled in. Warnes is a thread of ink with no swelling or tapering, and that stretched, spacious thread against the approachable body is the pair's most striking quality.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-devanagari: Expressive from the first stem, Warnes is rope-like in every bowl and tail. Anek Devanagari follows in a sans with open mouths and a tall middle zone, so paragraphs of it would feel breezy and easy going.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati reads clean and friendly, its lowercase rivaling the capitals. Warnes has no thick-to-thin shading at all, so a paragraph of the body text feels open and generous, with that gaping c giving each line room.
